results.author: Jan Kutschera | ADHD Founder
results.text:
Most task apps let an ADHD backlog become a museum.

The useful part of a bullet journal is harsher:

Rewrite every unfinished task tomorrow.

Move it forward, send it back, or kill it.

A task should earn another day. It should not inherit one.
